argv: SELECT CASE WHEN "file_id" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("file_id" AS TEXT)) END AS "file_id",CASE WHEN "annotation_off" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("annotation_off" AS TEXT)) END AS "annotation_off",CASE WHEN "visibility" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("visibility" AS TEXT)) END AS "visibility",CASE WHEN "type_idx" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("type_idx" AS TEXT)) END AS "type_idx",CASE WHEN "element_count" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("element_count" AS TEXT)) END AS "element_count" FROM annotations ORDER BY file_id,annotation_off
